Banner Component UI Enhancement Summary

# Banner Component UI Enhancement Summary

## Objective
Enhanced the HEXTRA application's Banner component with improved badge designs and subscription prompts while fixing the scrolling behavior to the "Available Plans" section.

## Changes Made

### Badge Design Updates
- Pro User Badge: Implemented a 3-pointed crown symbol (♛) with gold color (#FFC700) and animation
- Early Bird Badge: Implemented a gold star symbol (★) with matching gold color scheme and animation

### Text Updates
- Changed subscription prompt from "Subscribe for premium features" to "Level-Up"
- This terminology better aligns with the brand's messaging strategy

### Scrolling Behavior
- Implemented a simplified scrolling solution with a fixed position (500px)
- Ensured reliable navigation to the "Available Plans" section
- Optimized for consistent behavior across different devices and browsers

## Technical Implementation
- Modified the Banner.js component to update badge styling and animations
- Simplified complex DOM calculations for more reliable scrolling behavior
- Successfully built and tested the changes in a production environment

## Results
- More visually appealing user interface with consistent premium styling
- Clearer call-to-action for subscription upgrades
- More reliable navigation to subscription options

Fix: HEX input ENTER key functionality in Colorize section

Fixed issue where pressing ENTER in the HEX input field wasn't properly applying the selected color to the main image.

## Changes
- Enhanced event handling in SwatchDropdownField component to prevent event propagation issues
- Added focus maintenance to ensure input field keeps focus after ENTER key press
- Improved color processing trigger in App.js with setTimeout to ensure proper execution order
- Added debugging logs for easier troubleshooting

## Technical Details
- Added event.stopPropagation() to prevent other handlers from capturing the ENTER key event
- Implemented focus maintenance with setTimeout to preserve input field focus
- Wrapped processColor() call in setTimeout to ensure it runs after the current event cycle
- Maintained critical workflow: color wheel selection → preview update → HEX focus → Enter to apply
